summary.text: Meredith Dixon is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 20 who took office on January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Dixon was born in Ossining, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Chatham College in 1999 and a master's degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 2002.
Dixon's career experience includes owning the Blue Advantage Partners consulting firm.

In the 2025-2026 session, Dixon is vice chair of the Appropriations and Finance Committee and of the Commerce & Economic Development Committee, and also serves on the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
